Q: Disable auto creating statistics on table A:

I assume you know what you are doing. Disabling a statistics is generally a bad idea. Anyhow:

EXEC sp_autostats 'table_name', 'OFF'

More documentation here: https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms188775.aspx.

Edit: OP clarified that he wants to disable statistics for a temp table. Try this:

CREATE TABLE #someTempTable
(
    ID int PRIMARY KEY WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = ON),
    ...other columns...
)

If you don't have a primary key already, use an identity column for a PK.

Q: SSIS tasks executing in the wrong order A:

Be careful with the direction the constraint arrow points. I had this problem and it was all due to a constraint arrow going in the wrong direction from one task to another. Took me a looong time to notice one arrow head was pointing backwards in the task flow.

Q: Where are the built-in Markdown CSS files in Visual Studio Code? A:

On my Linux it is in /usr/share/code/resources/app/extensions/markdown-language-features/media folder.

Q: How can I find a specific consecutive sequence of rows in SQL without MATCH_RECOGNIZE? A:

I think this should work, but (sorry!) I do nog have to the time to create some sample data to test it, so I cannot say anything about performance...

WITH crimes_range_rbm as (
    SELECT 
        ts as ts_battery, 
        LEAD(TS) OVER (ORDER BY TS) as ts_robbery, 
        LAG(TS) OVER (ORDER BY TS) as ts_motor_vehicle_theft  
    FROM crimes as battery 
    WHERE battery.ts between 1755864000 and 1755873000
),
crimes_range_arbm as (
    SELECT 
        LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) as ts_assault,
        ts_robbery,
        ts_battery,
        ts_motor_vehicle_theft
    FROM crimes
    INNER JOIN crimes_range_rbm rbm on rbm.ts_robbery = crimes.ts 
)
SELECT * 
FROM crimes
WHERE ts between (select ts_assault from crimes_range_arbm) and (select ts_motor_vehicle_theft from crimes_range_arbm);
  • The crimes_range_rbm is finding battery with the previous occurred robbery, and the later occured theft.
  • The crimes_range_arbm will find the assault before the robbery
  • Finally the four records of this crime should be found.

Q: Hikari connection pool exhausted A:

You have to be careful when setting Hikari props like pool size and minimum idle. Increasing those values doesn't necessarily mean that you will get better throughputs or performance outcomes. Please check this. https://github.com/brettwooldridge/HikariCP/wiki/About-Pool-Sizing

Q: ImportError: No module named tensorflow - Can't install Tensorflow A:

I use Anaconda Navigator which includes Tensorflow. I use Spyder, it's a IDE of Anaconda Navigator similar to Matlab with variable explorer, very useful.

You have to go to the page https://www.anaconda.com/download/#macos

and download and install it. It's open source. Then open Spyder and call tensorflow lib. It's the easiest mode to run tensorflow and virtualenvs.
